export const detectLocation=()=>{return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{if(navigator.geolocation){navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(position=>{const{latitude,longitude}=position.coords;resolve({lat:latitude,lng:longitude});// Resolve with lat, lng
},error=>{reject('Unable to retrieve location. Ensure location permissions are enabled.');});}else{reject('Geolocation is not supported by this browser.');}});};
